scholarships.title: Beca Universidad de Chile (BUCH)
scholarships.official_source: Universidad de Chile - Direccion de Bienestar y Desarrollo Estudiantil (DIRBDE)

eligibility: Estar cursando el cuarto ano de ensenanza media en el 2026
Promedio de notas de la ensenanza media igual o superior a 6,0
Cartola del Registro Social de Hogares, dentro del tramo de calificacion socioeconomica de hasta el 90%
Rendir la bateria de pruebas PAES para la admision 2027 (diciembre 2026) y obtener al menos 700 puntos ponderados entre Competencia Lectora y Competencia Matematica M1
Postular a los beneficios estudiantiles MINEDUC para la admision 2027
Autorizar el consentimiento informado en la plataforma DEMRE para compartir los resultados PAES
No tener asignacion de Gratuidad, Beca Vocacion de Profesor u otro beneficio equivalente
existing.eligibility_summary: Chilean students in the fourth year of secondary education (2026), with a secondary-school average of 6.0 or above, within the 90% socioeconomic band of the Registro Social de Hogares, sitting the 2027 PAES admission battery with at least 700 weighted points across Competencia Lectora and Competencia Matematica M1, applying for MINEDUC student benefits for 2027 admission, and not holding MINEDUC gratuidad, Beca Vocacion de Profesor or an equivalent benefit.
benefits: Financia el valor completo de la matricula y el arancel de cualquier carrera o programa de pregrado de la Universidad de Chile
Annual renewal provided academic-progress and re-accreditation conditions are met
coverage: Matricula (enrolment fee) for the first year of the programme
Arancel (annual tuition) for any career or undergraduate programme of the Universidad de Chile
Renewed annually for the official duration of the programme
requirements: Application is made through the DIRBDE online form at https://postulacionbuch.uchile.cl/auth/login
Attach the Cartola del Registro Social de Hogares to the online form
Apply to a programme through the Sistema de Acceso a la Educacion Superior (SAES)
Be summoned to enrol and formalise the matricula within the University's deadlines
Complete the FOCES form and socio-economic accreditation with the academic unit's social worker
Complete the FUAS for the relevant academic period
documents: Cartola del Registro Social de Hogares (attached to the online application form)
Informe Social (may be requested where the Cartola is not available)
PAES 2026 results for admission 2027 (supplied by DEMRE/MINEDUC once published)
application_method: Attach the Cartola del Registro Social de Hogares
Shortlist ranked by the BUCH weighted score announced on 4 January 2027
Final selection result announced on 18 January 2027
existing.selection_notes: Candidates are ranked by the BUCH weighted score from PAES results: 25% Competencia Lectora score; 25% best score between Competencia Matematica M1 and M2; 20% best score among the elective History and Social Sciences and Science papers; 20% grade ranking score; 10% secondary-school grade average. The 100 highest-ranked eligible candidates are awarded.
existing.best_fit: High-achieving Chilean secondary-school leavers from low and middle socioeconomic households who have not won MINEDUC gratuidad and want a fully tuition-funded place at the Universidad de Chile.
existing.notes: Admission to the University and the scholarship are separate steps: the BUCH application does not replace SAES admission, and the award only becomes final once the candidate has been summoned to enrol and has formalised the matricula. If MINEDUC grants gratuidad or Beca Vocacion de Profesor, the ministerial benefit prevails; CAE/FSCU may complement BUCH. Award count is fixed at 100 per year by the University regulation.
existing.duration: Full official duration of the chosen programme (renEWed annually)
existing.program_type: University merit and socioeconomic need scholarship
